mapper.sql: l.id AS listing_id, l.buyer_sku_code, l.status AS listing_status, lv.version_no AS listing_version, sku.sku_code AS platform_sku_code, spu.spu_code AS platform_spu_code, lv.display_name, brand.brand_code, brand.brand_name, category.category_code, category.category_name, sku.fulfillment_type, lv.buyer_settlement_unit_price, lv.currency, availability.availability, availability.version AS availability_version, pricing.pricing_status AS pricing_status, l.management_mode, lv.source_buyer_pricing_version_id, pricing.current_version_id AS current_pricing_version_id, availability.valid_until, l.updated_at

FROM sc_buyer_listing l JOIN sc_buyer_listing_version lv ON lv.id = l.current_version_id JOIN sc_platform_sku sku ON sku.id = l.platform_sku_id JOIN sc_platform_spu spu ON spu.id = sku.spu_id JOIN sc_brand brand ON brand.id = spu.brand_id JOIN sc_product_category category ON category.id = spu.primary_category_id LEFT JOIN sc_buyer_listing_availability availability ON availability.listing_id = l.id LEFT JOIN sc_buyer_product bp ON bp.buyer_id = l.buyer_id AND bp.platform_sku_id = sku.id LEFT JOIN sc_buyer_sku_pricing pricing ON pricing.buyer_product_id = bp.id
